title: Align Before Aggregation: Basis-Consistent Federated LoRA under Heterogeneous Ranks
abstract: arXiv:2611.07598v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) under heterogeneous client capacities is increasingly important, and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with heterogeneous ranks makes it practical. Existing server-side aggregators compose local matrix updates $\Delta W_i$ from client-specific LoRA factors $(A_i,B_i)$ before aggregating them. Although these matrix updates lie in the same weight space $\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ and can be averaged directly, the LoRA factors that generate them may expressed client-specific local basis. In the typical compose--aggregate--factorize--dispatch loop, this basis inconsistency can make the rank-$r_i$ reference prefix dispatched to lower-rank clients unstable after server-side refactorization. In this work, we propose \textbf{FedAbA}, a basis-consistent federated LoRA aggregation framework for heterogeneous ranks. translated_title: 先对齐再聚合：异构秩下的基一致联邦 LoRA
translated_abstract: 在客户端能力异构的情况下对大语言模型进行联邦微调正变得日益重要，而采用异构秩的低秩适应使这一目标切实可行。现有的服务器端聚合器在聚合之前，先由客户端特定的 LoRA 因子 合成局部矩阵更新 ΔW_i。尽管这些矩阵更新位于相同的权重空间 R^{m×n} 中并可以直接平均，但生成它们的 LoRA 因子可能表达了客户端特定的局部基。在典型的“合成—聚合—分解—分发”循环中，这种基不一致性可能导致服务器端重新分解后，分发给低秩客户端的秩为 r_i 的参考前缀不稳定。在这项工作中，我们提出了 FedAbA，一个面向异构秩的基一致联邦 LoRA 聚合框架。FedAbA 首先提取每个客户端的局部基，并将其与对应的前缀进行对齐……
tldr: 提出 FedAbA 框架，在聚合前先提取并对齐各客户端 LoRA 因子的局部基，解决了异构秩联邦微调中因基不一致导致的参考前缀不稳定问题。
en_tdlr: FedAbA is a basis-consistent federated LoRA aggregation framework that extracts and aligns each client's local basis before aggregation, stabilizing federated LLM fine-tuning under heterogeneous ranks.
